## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- Standard partition filter (used in ALL queries)
WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = '${upper_region}'
  AND tz_type = 'local'

-- CPC/CPS deductions only
AND operation IN (1, 15)

-- CPM deductions only
AND operation = 11

-- All deductions
AND operation IN (1, 11, 15)

-- Live Ads pricing type filter
AND CAST(get_json_object(decoded_extinfo, '$.pricingType') AS int) IN (9, 10, 14, 19, 22)

-- Exclude system dummy records
AND keyword != 'system_dummy_negative_deduction'

-- Date range filter using timestamp (cross-timezone alignment)
AND timestamp < UNIX_TIMESTAMP(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(DATE'${grass_date}', 1), '${timezone}'), 'Asia/Singapore'))
AND timestamp >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(DATE'${grass_date}', '${timezone}'), 'Asia/Singapore'))
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- 1. JOIN with translog_event (hourly event log) for CPM impression details
-- Most common pattern: match by deduct_unique_id + adsid
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.ods_log_translog_event_hi__reg_s0_live translog_event
  ON translog_db.deduct_unique_id = translog_event.deduct_unique_id
  AND translog_db.adsid = translog_event.adsid

-- 2. JOIN with dim_advertise for ads metadata
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live advertise
  ON translog.adsid = advertise.ads_id
  AND translog.placement = advertise.placement

-- 3. JOIN with dim_advertiser for seller info
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dim_advertiser__reg_s0_live advertiser
  ON deduction_di.shop_id = advertiser.shop_id

-- 4. JOIN with exchange rate for USD conversion
LEFT JOIN mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live exrate
  ON deduction_di.grass_region = exrate.grass_region

-- 5. JOIN with credit topup for credit details
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dwd_advertiser_credit_topup_df__reg_s0_live credit_tab
  ON deduction_di.topup_order_id = credit_tab.order_id
  AND deduction_di.credit_order_type = credit_tab.credit_order_type
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- 1. Total cost per transaction (DAI balance delta)
dai_after_balance - dai_before_balance AS total_cost

-- 2. Revenue in local currency (divide by 10^5)
price / pow(10, 5) AS price_local
price / 100000.0 AS deduction_amt

-- 3. Credit type breakdown from paidFreeExpirySummary
aggregate(filter(entrys, x -> x.type = 1), 0L, (acc, x) -> acc + cast(x.amount as bigint)) AS entry_1  -- paid without expiry
aggregate(filter(entrys, x -> x.type = 2), 0L, (acc, x) -> acc + cast(x.amount as bigint)) AS entry_2  -- paid with expiry
aggregate(filter(entrys, x -> x.type = 3), 0L, (acc, x) -> acc + cast(x.amount as bigint)) AS entry_3  -- free without expiry
aggregate(filter(entrys, x -> x.type = 4), 0L, (acc, x) -> acc + cast(x.amount as bigint)) AS entry_4  -- free with expiry

-- 4. Explode adsCredits for per-credit-order deduction
FROM_JSON(get_json_object(decoded_extinfo, '$.adsCredits'),
  'array<struct<orderId:string,orderType:int,balanceBefore:string,balanceAfter:string,mainType:int,withExpiry:boolean,effectiveType:int,adsCreditId:string,consumptionType:int>>'
) AS ads_credits
LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(ads_credits) AS ads_credit

-- 5. Credit topup type classification
CASE
  WHEN ads_credit.mainType = 2 AND ads_credit.withExpiry = false THEN 1  -- paid credit without expiry
  WHEN ads_credit.mainType IN (2,5) AND ads_credit.withExpiry = true THEN 2  -- paid credit with expiry
  WHEN ads_credit.mainType IN (3,5) AND ads_credit.withExpiry = false THEN 3  -- free credit without expiry
  WHEN ads_credit.mainType = 3 AND ads_credit.withExpiry = true THEN 4  -- free credit with expiry
END AS credit_topup_type

-- 6. Rebate free credit calculation
SELECT deduct_unique_id, adsid,
  SUM(CAST(ads_credit.balanceBefore AS bigint) - CAST(ads_credit.balanceAfter AS bigint)) AS expense_rebate_free_credit_without_expiry
FROM ... LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(ads_credits) AS ads_credit
WHERE ads_credit.orderType = 19
GROUP BY deduct_unique_id, adsid

-- 7. CPM cost pro-rata allocation
round(entry_1 * (imp_cost_detail.adjusted_cost * 1.00000 / total_cost), 0) AS expense_paid_credit_without_expiry
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### 1. DWD Deduction Pipeline - CPC detail extraction (dwd_advertiser_deduction_di)

```sql
-- Extract CPC deduction details with decoded extinfo fields
SELECT deduct_unique_id, adsid AS ads_id, userid AS user_id,
    shopid AS shop_id, placement, itemid AS item_id,
    CAST(ads_credit.balanceBefore AS bigint) - CAST(ads_credit.balanceAfter AS bigint) AS deduction_amt,
    CAST(get_json_object(decoded_extinfo,'$.pricingType') AS int) AS pricing_type,
    CAST(get_json_object(decoded_extinfo,'$.campaignid') AS bigint) AS campaign_id,
    CAST(get_json_object(decoded_extinfo,'$.entrance') AS int) AS entrance,
    CAST(get_json_object(decoded_extinfo,'$.deductionInfo.quality') AS DOUBLE) AS pctr,
    CAST(get_json_object(decoded_extinfo,'$.deductionInfo.bidprice') AS BIGINT) AS bid_price
FROM mp_paidads.ods_shopee_ads_db__translog_tab_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}') AND grass_region = '${upper_region}'
  AND tz_type = 'local' AND operation IN (1, 15)
```

### 2. DWD Transaction Pipeline - Full transaction record (dwd_advertiser_transaction_di)

```sql
-- Build full transaction record with operation type mapping
SELECT id, shopid AS shop_id,
    IF(operation = 11, cpm.user_id, COALESCE(translog.userid, advertise.user_id)) AS user_id,
    adsid AS ads_id,
    price / pow(10, 5) AS price_local,
    CAST(operation AS tinyint) AS event_code,
    CASE WHEN operation = 1 THEN 'deduction'
         WHEN operation = 11 THEN 'deduct_imp'
         WHEN operation = 15 THEN 'deduction' END AS event_type,
    acc_before_balance / pow(10, 5) AS acc_before_balance_local
FROM mp_paidads.ods_shopee_ads_db__translog_tab_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region = '${upper_region}' AND grass_date = date('${grass_date}') AND tz_type = 'local'
```

### 3. DWD Performance Pipeline - CPM deduction with event details (dwd_advertise_performance_di)

```sql
-- CPM deduction joining translog_tab with translog_event for impression-level details
SELECT translog_db.adsid AS ads_id, translog_db.deduct_unique_id,
    dai_after_balance - dai_before_balance AS total_cost,
    cpm_detail.user_id, imp_cost_detail.adjusted_cost AS cost,
    1 AS deduct_impression
FROM mp_paidads.ods_shopee_ads_db__translog_tab_di__reg_s0_live AS translog_db
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.ods_log_translog_event_hi__reg_s0_live AS translog_event
  ON translog_db.deduct_unique_id = translog_event.deduct_unique_id
  AND translog_db.adsid = translog_event.adsid
LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(FROM_JSON(cpm_event_details_str, '...')) cpm_details pos1, cpm_detail
LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(imp_cost_details) imp_cost_details pos2, imp_cost_detail
WHERE pos1 = pos2
  AND translog_db.grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}') AND translog_db.operation = 11
```

### 4. Livestream Performance - Live Ads deduction (dwd_livestream_performance_di)

```sql
-- Livestream CPM deduction with pricing type filter
SELECT *, FROM_JSON(get_json_object(decoded_extinfo, '$.paidFreeExpirySummary.entries'),
    'array<struct<type:BIGINT, amount:string, effective_type:int>>') AS entrys
FROM mp_paidads.ods_shopee_ads_db__translog_tab_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}') AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local' AND operation = 11
  AND CAST(get_json_object(decoded_extinfo, '$.pricingType') AS int) IN (9, 10, 14, 19, 22)
```

### 5. Seller Report Diff Check - Translog DB aggregation

```sql
-- Aggregate translog for diff check against seller center report
SELECT grass_region, date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}') AS grass_date,
    hour(from_unixtime(timestamp)) AS h, placement,
    CASE WHEN operation = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS db_click,
    NVL(dai_after_balance, 0) - NVL(dai_before_balance, 0) AS db_cost
FROM mp_paidads.ods_shopee_ads_db__translog_tab_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date >= date_sub(date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'), 1)
  AND grass_date <= date_add(date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'), 1)
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND date(from_unixtime(timestamp)) = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
  AND operation IN (1, 11, 15)
```

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mp_paidads.ods_shopee_ads_db__translog_tab_di__reg_s0_live

| Metric | Formula | Seen in |
|--------|---------|---------|
| total_cost | `dai_after_balance - dai_before_balance` | dwd_deduction, dwd_performance, dwd_livestream |
| price_local | `price / pow(10, 5)` or `price / 100000.0` | dwd_transaction |

| expense_paid_credit_without_expiry | `round(entry_1 * (adjusted_cost / total_cost), 0)` | dwd_performance, dwd_livestream |
| db_cost | `NVL(dai_after_balance,0) - NVL(dai_before_balance,0)` | seller_report_diff |
| deduction_price | `(deductionInfo.deductionPrice + voucherDeductionPrice) / 100000.0` | dwd_performance |
